item.title: Hormuz oil flows plunge nearly 50% below pre-war levels: Tracker
item.description: According to the Hormuz Strait Tracker’s most recent estimate, the average has fallen from roughly 13 million barrels per day in late October to just 8 million by November 15.

item.title: IRGC Ground Force destroys PJAK separatist terrorist team on western borders
item.description: The IRGC Ground Force has announced the destruction of a team belonging to the PJAK separatist terrorist group along the country’s western borders by combatants of the Ansar al-Rasoul Commando Brigade.

item.title: IAEA’s politicized use of safeguards undermines its impartiality: Russian envoy
item.description: Russia’s Ulyanov says the IAEA is becoming increasingly partial in its dealings with countries like Iran.

item.title: NPT withdrawal a 'serious national demand' in Iran: Senior MP
item.description: MP Qashqavi has questioned NPT’s relevance after attacks on Iranian nuclear facilities, while highlighting Iran's military deterrence and its conditions for resuming diplomacy.

item.title: Iran FM to visit Pakistan and Oman in coming days
item.description: The Iranian foreign minister will attend an ECO ministerial meeting in Pakistan before travelling to Oman for talks with his counterpart.

item.title: Two violating oil tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz, one sinks: IRGC Navy
item.description: The IRGC Navy said the two tankers “suffered a very massive explosion” after hitting sea mines while attempting to transit Hormuz through an unauthorized route.

item.title: Iran, Afghanistan discuss expanding trade, customs operations
item.description: Agriculture minister puts bilateral trade at $2.7 billion and proposes deeper Iranian involvement in Afghan production chains.

item.title: 3D printing, reverse engineering, AI usher Iran into sophisticated manufacturing
item.description: In Qazvin, an advanced manufacturing ecosystem combining reverse engineering, metal 3D printing, artificial intelligence, and university research is opening new frontiers for Iran's domestic production of sophisticated industrial components and equipment.

item.title: New missile city signals regional shift; Iran rejects ‘neither-war-nor-peace state’: Ghalibaf
item.description: Iran’s parliament speaker asserts that the Islamic Republic’s position will not be determined by whether Washington prefers negotiations or war.

item.title: IRGC warns France against Israel's 'false-flag trap’ to turn Europe against Iran
item.description: The IRGC says that, unlike the US and Israel, civilians are not among the elite military force's targets.

item.title: Hezbollah: Iran proved ‘US is no longer a superpower’
item.description: Iran has exposed the limits of Washington’s military and political power in its confrontation with the US-Israeli axis, the Hezbollah official says.

item.title: Count your chickens first, then talk about winter: CBI chief to Bessent
item.description: CBI governor dismisses new US sanctions threats as premature, saying nearly $33 billion in foreign currency has been supplied.

item.title: Protesters clash with police near ASEAN summit over Trump visit
item.description: Hundreds of protesters, denouncing the expected visit of US President Donald Trump and the conflict in West Asia, clashed with police in Manila.

item.title: Palestinians mark Independence Declaration anniversary with 'Gaza Swims for Hope' event
item.description: Palestinians of various ages participated in a swimming event on the beach of Gaza City titled "Gaza Swims for Hope."

item.title: Philippines: Police clash with protesters opposing Trump’s ASEAN visit
item.description: Police clash with protesters in Manila opposing Trump’s visit and planned meeting with Philippine President Marcos during the ASEAN Summit.
